newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly down, trade slids.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly down, trade slids.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.05 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 503.12 from 503.35 on Thursday.
Total volume was 1.61 million dinars against 2.13 million dinars. Turnover on the first market was 1.4 million dinars with 46,185 shares changing hands.
Most of the prices were little changed, excepted BTEI bank which was up 0.38 dinar to 33 dinars and chemical firm ICF advancing 0.32 dinar to 56.02 dinars. ($1= 1.09 dinar)
